name: Entry Village
description: A small village that serves as the starting point for adventurers.

village_square.name: Village Square
village_square.description: The bustling center of the village, filled with villagers and market stalls.
village_square.look_around: You see villagers going about their daily routines, children playing, and merchants selling their goods.

blacksmith_shop.name: Blacksmith's Shop
blacksmith_shop.description: A small shop where the blacksmith forges weapons and armor.
blacksmith_shop.look_around: Sparks fly from the anvil. Racks of freshly hammered blades line the walls.

tavern.name: The Drunken Dragon Tavern
tavern.description: A lively tavern where adventurers gather to share stories and drinks.
tavern.look_around: A bard strums a lute in the corner while a group of mercenaries argues over a map.

village_gate.name: Village Gate
village_gate.description: The main gate leading out of the village to the surrounding wilderness.
